case: AIJ UWE Case G (Tsuiji-matsu) — flow behind a 7 m x 74 m x 2 m black-pine belt with a 1.2 m trunk gap
reference: Kurotani, Y., Kiyota, N. & Kobayashi, S. (2001) Windbreak effect of Tsuijimatsu in Izumo Part. 2, Summaries of technical papers of the AIJ Annual Meeting D-2, 745-746; AIJ UWE Benchmark Dataset Case G, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.15589666 (CC BY 4.0); Kikumoto, H., Okaze, T., Yoshie, R. et al. (2026) Japan Architectural Review 9(1) e70083, doi:10.1002/2475-8876.70083, section 3.7; Mochida, A. et al. (2008) JWEIA 96, 1667-1677, doi:10.1016/j.jweia.2008.02.055

idealisation.primary: 2-D idealisation: a 6.4 m slab, the belt through both slip planes (infinite width)
idealisation.check: 3-D: the real 74 m belt, half domain with the centre plane on the y = 0 symmetry plane
idealisation.why: the data paper's Figure 7 is captioned 'Geometry of a two-dimensional pine tree in Case G'; the measured plane is the centre of a belt 10.6 H wide; the half belt (EDDY3D_AIJ_G_FINITE) measures the end effect at the 28 points (endEffect.*)

inflow.kind: wind.inlet = manual: the workbook's own inflow (LF_caseG.xls, Geometry sheet, Fig. 1 and the CFD note)
inflow.profile: U = 5.6 (z/9)^0.22 m/s, k = 3.02 m2/s2 at every height, epsilon = Cmu^0.5 k |dU/dz| (Pk = epsilon)
inflow.floor: smooth (nutkWallFunction): the tabulated inlet's floor; the site's z0 (0.030 m from a log-law fit of AF_caseG.csv) is not represented

k.assertion: none. Eddy3D models trees as a momentum sink only (Darcy-Forchheimer, f = 2 Cd LAD): there are no canopy k/epsilon source terms, so the modelled k behind the belt is recorded against the measurement and never asserted

lad.provenance.note: LAD and Cd are NOT in the dataset (only the shading rate, 81 %). The three crowns are the repository's vegetation library entries nearest a pruned pine belt; nothing is fitted.
lad.provenance.beerLambertNote: -ln(1 - 0.81) / (G x 2 m) with G = 0.5 assumed (spherical leaf angles): inside the library bracket 1.5 ... 3.5

quantity: U/U_H and k/U_H^2 at the 28 points, U_H the wind at the tree height (7 m): the measured mean scalar speed against the modelled |U| and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k), both over the model's own U(7 m) at x = -35 m, and over the imposed U_H = 5.299 m/s; LAD and Cd are not in the dataset
armProvenance: the 'Conifer' crown on the real 74 m belt: a half domain with the measured plane on the symmetry plane

zone.note: expected is the stated belt plus the 1 cm nudge; with the nudge the top cell is in, so the zone is ~1.03 of it by construction

solveLog.stoppedBy: the iteration limit: the log has no 'solution converged' line (residualControl not met)

scoresFrom: the pairs file (validation/dispersion_metrics.py); the fixture's own scores, computed against RS_caseG.csv, are in Eddy3D's results.json
